title: Mouse Click
blurb: The tiny plastic snap that runs the digital world, captured cleanly and without room noise. Editors need this constantly — UI walkthroughs, decision moments, the dramatic press of send — because a click is one of the few sounds that implies human intent all by itself. Somebody chose to do that. It is also weirdly satisfying on loop, as the entire mechanical keyboard community will readily and at length testify. Professionally recorded and ready for every 'and then I pressed the button' story you will ever need to tell.
origin: A clean single mouse click recording.
